app.name: Athena AI Risk Terminal
app.subtitle: A quantitative finance and risk management platform for portfolio, trading, and control workflows.

common.environmentValue: Development foundation with bilingual navigation and API connectivity.
common.placeholderDescription: This module has been scaffolded to match the architecture and is ready for future business logic, services, and domain calculations.
common.comingSoon: Implementation comes next in the service and domain layers.

workflow.portfolioSelectorDescription: Use one portfolio context across Market Data, Equity Analysis, Portfolio Builder and Trade Simulator.
workflow.portfolioModeDescription: Reuse a holding from the selected portfolio.
workflow.standaloneModeDescription: Type or choose a single ticker without portfolio context.
workflow.simulationOnlyNotice: Simulation only. No trades are executed.
workflow.unsupportedEquityHolding: This holding is not a common equity. Equity Analysis is designed for stocks, so ETF or fixed income diagnostics can be incomplete.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Central overview for the initial Athena project foundation.
dashboard.heroSubtitle: A quantitative finance and risk management platform built for scalable front-office and middle-office workflows.

descriptions.riskDna: AI explanation and scoring layer will connect here later.

equityAnalysis.title: Equity Analysis
equityAnalysis.subtitle: Single-stock fundamentals, ratios, valuation models and analyst-style diagnostics for demo large-cap equities.
equityAnalysis.apiError: Equity analysis API is unavailable. Start the backend or check the dev script output.

marketOrganization.title: Market Organization & Equity Instruments
marketOrganization.description: Security type, listing venue, voting rights, liquidity context and market value versus book value.

company.title: Company Overview
company.description: Company identity, ticker, sector, industry, market capitalization, shares outstanding and business description.

overview.title: Company Overview & Security Profile
overview.description: Issuer identity, common equity profile, dividend policy, book value context and risk/return notes.

industry.title: Industry & Business Model
industry.description: Industry structure, competitive position, revenue drivers, pricing power and operating leverage.

business.title: Business Model & Revenue Drivers
business.description: Revenue drivers, segment mix, geographic exposure placeholders, pricing power, cyclicality and operating leverage.

fundamentals.title: Financial Statement Fundamentals & Ratios
fundamentals.description: Income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, profitability, liquidity, leverage and sustainable growth metrics.

ratios.title: Ratios & Quality Metrics
ratios.description: Profitability, liquidity, leverage, efficiency, dividend and quality metrics from deterministic demo fundamentals.

growth.title: Growth, Forecasting & Sustainable Growth
growth.description: Revenue growth, EPS growth, dividend growth, retention ratio and sustainable growth diagnostics.

valuation.title: Valuation Models
valuation.description: Gordon Growth Model, dividend discount framing, valuation multiples, model-implied value and sensitivity analysis.

relative.title: Relative Valuation & Multiples
relative.description: Company multiples compared with demo peer medians and premium or discount classifications.

peers.title: Benchmark & Peer Comparison
peers.description: Benchmark symbol, peer table, profitability versus peers, growth versus peers and sector-relative diagnostics.

corporateActions.title: Corporate Actions & Shareholder Returns
corporateActions.description: Dividend profile, payout, retention, stock split placeholder, repurchase placeholder and shareholder yield.

governance.title: Governance, ESG & Risk Factors
governance.description: Governance and ESG placeholders plus company, industry, financial, valuation, liquidity and regulatory risks.

diagnostics.title: Analyst Summary & Investment Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Educational diagnostics that summarize strengths, risks and analytical classifications without investment advice.

ratios.title: Ratios & Quality Metrics
ratios.currentRatioFormula: Current ratio = current assets / current liabilities.
ratios.quickRatioFormula: Quick ratio = cash + receivables + marketable securities, divided by current liabilities.

valuation.marginDescription: Compares dividend-model value with the current demo market price. It is a model signal, not a recommendation.
valuation.extremeMarginWarning: Extreme model gap: dividend-based valuation can be very sensitive for low-yield or buyback-heavy companies.
valuation.modelLimitation: Dividend models assume stable payout behavior and constant long-run growth. Read this with multiples and peer context.

ggm.title: Gordon Growth Model Calculator
ggm.invalid: Required return must be greater than growth rate.
ggm.limitation: GGM is most useful for stable dividend payers and is highly sensitive when required return and growth are close.

summaryPanel.title: Analyst-Style Summary
summaryPanel.note: Educational analysis only. Not investment advice.

marketData.title: Market Data
marketData.subtitle: Inspect demo assets, prices, returns, volatility, and data quality.
marketData.selectorDescription: Choose a tracked asset to inspect clean prices, returns, volatility and benchmark diagnostics.
marketData.apiError: Market data API is unavailable. Start the backend or check the dev script output.
marketData.emptyOutliers: No outliers flagged in the current sample.

assetOverview.title: Asset Overview
assetOverview.description: Price history, OHLCV records, volume, liquidity context and data quality for the selected asset.

returns.title: Returns Analytics
returns.description: Simple returns, log returns, cumulative performance and annualized return profile.

riskVolatility.title: Risk & Volatility Analytics
riskVolatility.description: Variance, standard deviation, daily and annualized volatility, rolling volatility and drawdown behavior.

distribution.title: Distribution & Statistical Profile
distribution.description: Distribution shape, percentiles, skewness, kurtosis and outlier diagnostics.

benchmark.title: Benchmark & Relative Analysis
benchmark.description: Relative performance, active return, correlation, covariance, beta and single-asset Sharpe ratio.

context.title: Market Context
context.description: Moving averages, momentum and planned macro market data needed for richer analysis.

portfolio.title: Portfolio Builder
portfolio.subtitle: Institutional portfolio construction, allocation, risk, policy and performance analytics from demo data.

empty.title: No portfolio selected
empty.message: Create or select a portfolio to begin the workflow.

workbench.title: Portfolio management cockpit
workbench.description: Select a portfolio, review the institutional workflow, and move between focused analytics tabs without losing context.

positions.title: Positions
positions.name: Name
positions.emptyMessage: Add a position to start calculating allocation, concentration and portfolio diagnostics.

sections.allocationDescription: Review portfolio exposures by asset, sector, currency and asset type using invested-weight allocation.
sections.riskDescription: HHI, effective holdings, top holdings and demo covariance assumptions grouped for concentration review.
sections.processDescription: Planning, execution and feedback organized as a professional IPS workflow.
sections.policyDescription: Objectives, constraints, risk tolerance and policy warnings.
sections.investorDescription: Investor type, objectives, liability profile and ability versus willingness to take risk.
sections.constraintsDescription: Grouped breaches and warnings from the current demo policy limits.
sections.targetAllocationDescription: Compare current weights with policy targets and tolerance bands.
sections.rebalancingDescription: Estimated trades only. No order routing or execution is triggered.
sections.performanceDescription: Beginning value, ending value, HPR, TWR and placeholder MWR metrics.
sections.riskAdjustedDescription: Sharpe, Treynor, Jensen alpha, information ratio and tracking error placeholders.
sections.capmDescription: Required return, beta, expected return gap and utility score from deterministic inputs.
sections.diagnosticsDescription: Current quality signals, implementation limits and next analytical steps.
sections.benchmarkDescription: Current placeholder benchmark exposures and active-weight diagnostics.
sections.behavioralDescription: ETF exposure, single-stock exposure and educational behavioral diagnostics.

performance.costBasisDemo: Uses cost basis as demo beginning value

diagnostics.noConstraintBreachesMessage: The current demo policy does not flag any active breach.

marketDataIntegration.title: Market Data Integration
marketDataIntegration.description: Prepared bridge to reuse Market Data return series, aligned returns and data-quality endpoints.
marketDataIntegration.message: Portfolio risk analytics currently use deterministic demo assumptions. Future versions will connect Market Data return series for realized volatility, covariance, VaR, CVaR and tracking error.

riskSource.title: Risk Data Source
riskSource.description: Source, coverage and fallback status for realized portfolio risk metrics.
riskSource.explanation: Realized risk metrics are calculated from Market Data return series when available. If return history is incomplete, Athena falls back to deterministic demo assumptions and labels the affected metrics.

tradeSimulator.title: Trade Simulator
tradeSimulator.subtitle: Institutional pre-trade analysis for portfolio impact, risk, suitability, costs and policy constraints.

workbench.title: Institutional trade simulation
workbench.description: Build a proposed order, inspect its portfolio impact, and review suitability before any execution decision.

ticket.title: Trade Ticket
ticket.description: Enter the proposed buy or sell order and review estimated implementation costs before simulation.

summary.title: Simulation Result Summary
summary.description: Decision status, main reason, estimated cost and suitability outcome. No trade is executed.
summary.emptyMessage: Complete the trade ticket and run a simulation to see pre-trade analytics.

riskSource.explanation: Realized risk metrics are calculated from Market Data return series when available. If return history is incomplete, Athena falls back to deterministic demo assumptions and labels the affected metrics.

compliance.title: Compliance & Constraints
compliance.description: Policy, concentration, cash, turnover and active-risk warnings generated from deterministic demo checks.
compliance.noWarningsMessage: The proposed trade does not trigger a demo policy warning.

riskMonitor.title: Risk Monitor
riskMonitor.subtitle: Portfolio risk surveillance, limits, stress testing and active risk monitoring.

workbench.title: Institutional risk management cockpit
workbench.description: Monitor portfolio risk, concentration, liquidity, benchmark deviation and IPS-style limits from one control surface.

empty.title: No portfolio selected
empty.message: Select a portfolio to run risk surveillance.

sections.concentrationDescription: Issuer, sector, top-holdings and cash risk checks.
sections.limitsDescription: Current portfolio values compared with institutional risk thresholds.
sections.metricsDescription: Realized metrics use Market Data return series when available, otherwise demo assumptions are labeled.
sections.stressDescription: Deterministic shocks for equity, technology, rates, risk-off, single-name and liquidity events.
sections.sectorContributionDescription: Sector-level aggregation of the risk contribution engine.
